resources.string: No night recorded with sleep stages.
Weighted average: duration relative to your need, efficiency, deep and REM sleep, minutes awake and timing. Deep and REM are estimates from heart rate and breathing: they weigh less than duration.
Calibration: %1$s/%2$s nights in the last 90 days. A few weekend nights are needed too.
Outer ring (blue): last night. Inner ring: the optimal times for your chronotype.
The chronotype is calculated from your sleep midpoint on free days, after at least %1$s nights (now %2$s).

From your sleep midpoint on free nights (Friday and Saturday), corrected for sleep caught up at the weekend, over the last %1$s nights. Wake-up and bedtime: the midpoint plus and minus half of your sleep need.
